mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, feature, subject_a_id, subject_b_id, content_hash, payload, warnings, generated_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_output_cache (workspace_id, feature, subject_a_id, subject_b_id, content_hash, payload, warnings, generated_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{feature}, #{subjectAId}, #{subjectBId}, #{contentHash}, #{payload}, #{warnings}, #{generatedAt}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content_hash = incoming.content_hash, payload = incoming.payload, warnings = incoming.warnings, generated_at = incoming.generated_at
